stage: Production: real customers and money; 2 VMs x 4 sync gunicorn workers

issues.title: Oversell / lost update on stock
issues.match_hint: Stock is read outside the transaction, then written back as an absolute value (stock = old - qty). Concurrent checkouts both pass the check, so both orders succeed for the same units (oversell). The absolute write loses decrements, so stored stock ends too high; it never goes negative, which is why a CHECK (stock >= 0) alone would not catch it (there is none anyway).

issues.title: Payment webhook is not idempotent
issues.match_hint: PayGate retries until 2xx (at-least-once). Each delivery re-inserts a payment row (event_id not UNIQUE), re-credits cashback, buys another shipping label, re-sends email. No dedupe on event id.

issues.title: Wallet balance read-modify-write (lost update)
issues.match_hint: get_balance then UPDATE balance = computed value; concurrent cashback/spend lose updates; spend can overdraw. No ledger, no lock.

issues.title: Money handled as binary float
issues.match_hint: total = float(price) * qty; charge amount int(total * 100) truncates (can undercharge by a cent); REAL / DOUBLE PRECISION columns for totals, payments, wallet balance.

issues.title: Email failure cancels and refunds a paid, shipped order
issues.match_hint: Side-effect failure (SMTP) marks the order failed and refunds the payment even though payment succeeded and a shipping label was bought.

issues.title: Scheduler runs inside every gunicorn worker on every VM
issues.match_hint: BackgroundScheduler started in create_app; 4 workers x 2 VMs = nightly job runs 8 times.

issues.title: Reconcile job adds a full recount to sold_count (non-idempotent)
issues.match_hint: sold_count = sold_count + SUM(all paid quantity) every run, so the count inflates nightly (and 8x with SO-6). sold_count feeds supplier royalties (money).

issues.title: Carrier API call with no timeout on sync workers
issues.match_hint: requests.post without timeout inside the webhook; sync gunicorn workers; a slow carrier blocks workers until gunicorn's 60s kill, taking the whole API down.

issues.title: SMTP connection without timeout
issues.match_hint: smtplib.SMTP(host) with no timeout in the request path.

issues.title: DB connection leaked when a query raises
issues.match_hint: query()/execute() return the connection only on success; an exception leaks it. After maxconn failures the worker's pool is exhausted (ThreadedConnectionPool raises PoolError) until restart.

issues.title: Backup can silently fail and rotation deletes good copies
issues.match_hint: No set -e / pipefail (pg_dump | gzip masks failures, leaving a tiny valid gzip), no verification, unconditional 7-day rotation, backups only on the VM's local disk.

issues.title: Health check is static; LB and deploy rely on it
issues.match_hint: /health returns ok without checking the DB; the LB keeps routing to broken instances and deploy verification proves nothing.

issues.title: Order history unbounded
issues.match_hint: GET /orders returns every order for the user, no LIMIT/pagination.

issues.title: Webhook does slow side effects before acknowledging
issues.match_hint: Cashback, label purchase and email all run inline before the 2xx; slow work causes provider timeouts and retries, which amplify SO-2.

bonus: Cashback silently lost when the user has no wallets row (UPDATE matches 0 rows)
Unpaid orders hold stock forever (no expiry of pending_payment orders); checkout creation failure after commit strands stock
Migrations applied by hand; deploy has no migration step / ordering
deploy.sh runs git pull on the tree it lives in
DB pool built without connect_timeout / keepalives / statement_timeout
SMTP_HOST silently falls back to localhost
No CHECK (stock >= 0) or other DB-level invariants
Webhook does not check the order state before marking paid (out-of-order / already failed orders)
Payment amount not compared with the order total
Request ID generated but never logged
